plugins.name: atlanai
plugins.description: Your organization's skills, agents, knowledge and MCP servers, from the Atlan registry. One sign-in, no API key.

plugins.name: atlanai-analytics
plugins.description: Set up a repository for talk-to-data in Claude or Codex: combine dashboards and query history, publish metrics and saved SQL to Trident, and ask questions from released context. Also supports warehouse analytics, business ontology and explicit agent build, eval and improve workflows.

plugins.name: atlanai-mods
plugins.description: Claude Code mod for the Atlan registry: registry reads run without a prompt, writes ask first, archive and move show what depends on the artifact, temporary gateway errors tell Claude how to retry, Atlan calls read as one line in the transcript, a pane lists what the session touched, a band follows a skill publish, /atlan skills picks a skill to load, a registry skill that clearly fits a request is named to Claude, and the status line reports a broken or degraded Atlan connection.
